articles.title: Fourth Generation Lawyer Launches Campaign for Bell County Court at Law
articles.excerpt: Gauntt said the court has had only two presiding judges, Gerald Brown and current Judge Rebecca DePew, and that DePew is retiring (Killeen Daily Herald).

articles.title: Locals Vying for County Seats in Primary Elections
articles.excerpt: 2026 election: The Herald listed Gauntt as the uncontested Republican candidate for County Court at Law seat No. 3 in the March 3, 2026 primary (Killeen Daily Herald).
